_comment: Created by JXP and Claude. Pointing limits per site, read by night_planner.site_limits. Hour angles in hours (east negative), angles in degrees; null means no limit. A run can override any value with --limit KEY=VALUE. Only the Lick/Kast pipeline reads this file so far.

_sources.ha_east: Lick control system, -05:40; adopted by the author 2026-10-14
_sources.dec_max: Shane mechanical limit as used since the first Lick runs; UCSC AstroScheduler v1.3.0 uses +72 (unresolved, see context/claudes_brain.md v0.57)
_sources.dec_min: no southern limit has been applied
_sources.airmass_max: none at Lick: the window is set by the HA limits alone (AstroScheduler uses 1.7)
